title: a declaration duplicated across files is rejected

failure.justification: The rule is stated without a detection stage; static analysis, import loading or execution may report it. The program must not complete.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 5.1/11.1: files share one declaration space, so two objects named Greeter collide.
